title: SeedVR2 7B restore at x3, DA settings
description: The last stage of the DA workflow on its own: SeedVR2 7B (INT8) makes a picture three times bigger and redraws the detail a plain resize cannot, in one step with tiled encoding (512, overlap 64), then puts the input's colors back (lab). A 1 megapixel picture becomes 9 (about 15 GB of graphics memory; the node refuses a result over 16.8 megapixels). The group is a library group with the model inside: save it to the library to drop it after any other template.
